name: WorkOS
subtitle: B2B identity: AuthKit, SSO and directory sync
creator: Michael Grinich
description: A developer platform for selling software to businesses. AuthKit handles sign-up and sign-in, and add-ons provide enterprise single sign-on (SAML), user provisioning from company directories (SCIM) and audit logs.

languages.written: SDKs in Node, Python, Ruby, Go, Java, PHP, .NET and more

concepts.explanation: Keep users in step with a company's HR system.

codeSamples.label: TypeScript · Next.js with AuthKit

pros: Most generous free tier for user management

pricing.summary: AuthKit user management free up to 1,000,000 MAU, then $2,500 per extra million. Enterprise SSO and directory sync: $125 per connection per month, with volume discounts.
